atoms.title: Adversary skill levels (low-skilled vs high-skilled / zero-days); motivation
atoms.objective: Classify a wireless attacker by skill tier based on the tools and techniques they use, and explain how motivation shapes which public Wi-Fi threats you face in practice.

atoms.title: Evil twin attack
atoms.objective: Explain how an evil twin attack works at the network level, identify the indicators that reveal a rogue access point in a wireless scan, and apply those indicators to detect one programmatically.

atoms.title: Jamming / denial-of-service attack
atoms.objective: Explain how radio-frequency jamming causes a wireless denial-of-service, describe what a sustained jamming event looks like in signal-strength monitoring data, and implement a detector that flags sustained...

atoms.title: War driving; protecting yourself (verify SSIDs, avoid open networks, VPN)
atoms.objective: Explain what war driving is and why it enables targeted wireless attacks, evaluate a Wi-Fi network against a set of risk criteria, and apply a systematic risk-flagging process to decide whether connecting is safe.
